evaluation_rule: A passing non-reference profile requires two consecutive passing attempts with stable exact identity under the bound budget and regime. A measured budget failure is reported immediately. Missing identity fields or evidence is not_evaluable.
comparison_rule: Report metric deltas against the reference attempts, but do not infer equality from shared budget compliance.
equivalence_ceiling: This protocol establishes no equivalence. It reports the three declared interaction metrics under exact identity and evidence bindings; it does not establish whole-browser, whole-platform, visual, accessibility, semantic, or product equivalence.
claim_ceiling: Candidate differential evidence only. No product approval, conformance, admission, activation, publication, release, deployment, or external-effect authority.
